title: Dairy Products Company for Sale in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
tagline: 24-year-old Vietnamese nutritional milk powder based in Tan Tao Industrial Park, Ho Chi Minh City. - The sale includes the dairy brand, trademarks, registered SKUs, proprietary product formulas, packaging designs, regulatory and registration dossiers, and associated machinery. - Operations have been suspended for about three years due to COVID-19 impacts and working capital constraints. - In the last year of operations, reported sales were approximately VND 262.81 billion with an estimated EBITDA margin of about 7%. - The owner is seeking a strategic buyer to relaunch production, strengthen distribution, and scale the brand nationally. - The transaction is structured as a sale of only production assets and intellectual property; the legal company and factory real estate (land and building) with an outstanding bank loan are excluded from the deal.
